scope: Offline SDK/framework implementation only; not live Azure evidence

observations.requestBoundary: Genuine pinned SDK/framework calls to a synthetic loopback HTTP server; no external model calls or TLS-validation bypass
observations.existingGatewayContract: Exact POST /openai/v1/responses, APIM key header, no project discovery, dated query, conversation API or topology change
observations.frameworkContinuation: Reused independent AgentSession instances send the preceding response ID and one current user message; no local history replay
observations.sdkDefaultCookies: Stock shared HTTP client/jar automatically resends one conversation's cookie on its continuation, an unrelated first turn and a stateless request
observations.defaultProfileFailure: Synthetic gateway returns UnexpectedAffinityCookie for the contaminated new/stateless requests; this is not live APIM or off-mode proof
observations.configuredCookies: One automatic handler/jar per conversation; interleaved continuations stay separate; stateless and affinity-off handlers disable cookies
observations.responseHandling: Genuine typed parsing plus shared validation; malformed typed fields cannot become raw-JSON success; actual multi-value headers retained
observations.bounds: One exact-route transport attempt per turn and planned run-wide budget; no SDK retry, redirect, hidden tool loop or history replay
observations.cookieEvidence: Fingerprints observe received/session-jar state, not transport-injected outbound SDK headers
